name: lud32
brief: LU decomposition without pivoting of a 32x32 fp32 matrix A (see plain.cpp, the reference: outputs U[k][i] for i >= k and the multipliers L[k][j] for j > k, stored as in plain.cpp; other elements are not checked). Keep the exact top signature extern "C" void lu_kernel(data_t A[N][N], data_t L[N][N], data_t U[N][N]).
